description: Extract hedging and certainty cues (may, probably, clearly, approximately) from text with offsets — Finds hedge and booster cues in an agent's or source's text using a fixed English lexicon (modals, epistemic verbs, adverbs and adjectives, approximators, shield phrases, certainty boosters) plus caller-supplied phrases, and returns each cue with its category, the sentence it sits in, and offsets in UTF-16, code points, UTF-8 bytes and graphemes. Rule-based and English only: a cue is a word match,

extraCues.description: Caller cues added to the lexicon.

phrase.description: Literal phrase, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries.

name: hedge-extract
